assay: bulk RNA-seq (Novogene, Illumina), left ventricle of 22-month-old C57BL/6 male mice (S2.1.p1, S2.2.p1)
sample_inclusion: sedentary vs swimming, n = 4 per group (S2.2.p1); the resistance-running arm was not sequenced
primary_estimand: Effect of 8-week swimming training versus sedentary on left-ventricle transcript expression in aged (22-month) male mice
planned_contrasts: Swimming vs Sedentary (S2.2.p1, S3.1.p1; paper gives no DE-transcript count)
paper_method: Ballgown transcript-level test (linear-model F-test on log2(FPKM+1)), adjusted p (S2.2.p1)
secondary_paper_rule: fold-change > 2 and P < 0.05 for heatmap, GO and iRegulon gene sets (S3.1.p1, S3.1.p3, FIG1 E-H); FIG1 C/G/H legends say log2 fold-change > 2 instead
paper_results: No DE-transcript count reported. KEGG top-10 down: oxidative phosphorylation, ROS, diabetic cardiomyopathy; GSEA up: cardiac muscle contraction, cGMP-PKG, longevity, mitophagy, mTOR; Usf2 FPKM higher in swimming (FIG5C, t-test P<0.05)
